tools.name: search_items
tools.description: Find PixilUI items for a UI job. Describe what the interface has to do in plain words ("ask before the agent sends", "show tool calls with their output", "modal to confirm a delete"). Searches titles, descriptions, when-to-use notes and tags and returns the best matches first. Call this before writi

tools.name: list_items
tools.description: Browse every PixilUI item, optionally filtered by category or tier. Returns slug, title, kind, category, tier and a one-line description.

tools.name: get_item
tools.description: Everything needed to use one item: when to use it and when not, the props table, keyboard, accessibility, motion, files, npm dependencies and the install command. Free items include their source. Pro items include source only when a valid Pro token is sent.

tools.name: get_install_command
tools.description: One shadcn CLI command that installs every listed item into the project, plus the components.json registries snippet to add once. Pro items also need the PIXILUI_TOKEN environment variable.

tools.name: get_source
tools.description: The raw files of one item with their install paths, for projects that cannot run the shadcn CLI. Prefer get_install_command. Pro items need a valid Pro token. shape "standalone" returns one self-contained .tsx instead (free components): it needs only react and motion, no Tailwind and no other items.

tools.name: get_skill
tools.description: The PixilUI skill for coding agents: SKILL.md and its rule files (design, motion, copy, accessibility, composition, responsive, checklist, components by job, a worked example). Call without a file for SKILL.md and the file list, or with a file name for one file.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "get_install_command" references sensitive artifacts (environment variable). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
